data.title: Numbers — Beginner · Lesson 3
data.subject: numbers
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Sandy shores and sunny skies...

[Hook]
Waves are crashing… Las olas rompiendo
Counting stars… Contando estrellas
Let's unwind… Relajémonos
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres
Feel the rhythm of the sea.

[Verse]
Zero point five… Cero coma cinco
Seagulls fly… Gaviotas vuelan
A quarter… Un cuarto
Of the day is gone.
Sand between our toes… Arena entre los dedos
Three quarters… Tres cuartos
Of fun, come on!
One fifth… Un quinto
Of the sunset's glow.
Two thirds… Dos tercios
Of the ocean's flow.

[Hook]
Waves are crashing… Las olas rompiendo
Counting stars… Contando estrellas
Let's unwind… Relajémonos
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres
Feel the rhythm of the sea.

[Verse]
One eighth… Un octavo
Of the night is near.
One hundred percent… Cien por ciento
Of smiles and cheer.
One trillion… Un billón
Stars up in the sky.
Seis… Six
Footsteps in the sand.
Siete… Seven
Dreams hand in hand.

[Bridge]
La luna brilla… The moon is bright
Reflecting on the water.
El sonido… The sound
